note: Sogebank's schedule of charges (March 2026, DCRP 27022026; an image-only document read by eye), before the turnover tax (TCA): its passbook savings account carries no monthly account-keeping fee; its classic current account carries a monthly fee of 1,250 gourdes. Reactivation, passbook, chequebook and transfer charges aren't modelled.
